stem: A pediatric dentist is counseling the parents of a child whose first primary teeth are just beginning to erupt. Which set of topics best matches the caries prevention information that should be covered?

options.text: Frequent sugar intake, prolonged breastfeeding, hygiene habits, and optimally fluoridated community water
Sugar intake alone, because feeding practices and community water are outside the scope of counseling at this stage
Hygiene habits and fluoridated water only, with all dietary topics deferred to a later visit
Prolonged breastfeeding only, because sugar frequency is not relevant until several teeth are present
